sn3.6:2.2: There are few in the world, great king, who, having attained the highest kinds of pleasure, do not get intoxicated with them, do not grow heedless of them, do not take a liking for sensual pleasures, and do not go against the precepts.
sn3.6:2.3: But most of the world, having attained the highest kinds of pleasure, do get intoxicated with them, do grow heedless of them, do take a liking for sensual pleasures, and do go against the precepts.”
